thread:
morgan: Quick QA  how should the sidebar react when a deep-link points to an item that was moved in the IA sweep? e.g. old /workspaces/99/models -> now /assets/models. Preserve URL or redirect?

tara: Preserve public URLs. Router should resolve aliases and show a UI hint. One-time toast on first visit saying it moved.

devin: Implementation: router tries exact -> alias lookup -> resolved route. We'll normalize the breadcrumb to the canonical path so users see the current hierarchy.

sam: A11y: when expanding groups for deep-links, move focus to the item and announce via aria-live: "Opened: X, now under Assets > Models". The moved-pill must be a focusable button if it has tooltip.

alex: UX: expand group, smooth-scroll to item, highlight briefly, update breadcrumbs to new path, and show small "moved from Workspaces" pill with tooltip linking to migration doc. Track clicks.

deploy-bot: scheduled staging deploy: 2024-12-07 01:00 UTC

morgan: Plan: dev adds alias mapping + focus/scroll flow; design provides toast + pill visual; a11y adds acceptance criteria. I'll open the spec PR and tag owners.

tara: Follow-up: internal admin links should get a migration warning, not silent break.

devin: I'll add an org-level toggle in the mapping file for legacy admin aliases.

alex: Also log percent of deep-links resolved via alias for two weeks after rollout.
